intro: Houseboats drifting through Kerala's backwaters. That is Alleppey in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Alleppey
paragraphs: Alleppey (Kerala) is known for its backwaters, romantic and nature experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to February.
